en.name: Archons
en.ability: Venti, Zhongli, Raiden Shogun, Nahida, and Focalors are Archons. Each night*, an alive player learn how many Archons are still alive. Poisoned or drunk player might yield false info.[]

revisions.v1: Venti, Zhongli, Raiden Shogun, Nahida, and Focalors are Archons. Each night*, an alive player learn how many Archons are still alive. Poisoned or drunk player might yield false info.[]

en.otherNightReminder: ST choose an alive player and places a "Blessed" reminder mark next to his character mark. Then, before using his ability, tell him how many Archons are alive.
